column1: Top-ranked person/customer has the highest sales and should be studied for successful sales patterns.
High-profit performers should be prioritized because they contribute more to overall profitability.
Persons with positive growth should be monitored and their successful practices can be replicated.
High AOV performers indicate stronger order value and can be used as a benchmark for increasing order size.
Focus on improving sales, profitability, growth and average order value together instead of relying on sales alone.
